description: This file contains unit tests for numeric type serialization support in Orleans, focusing on widening and narrowing conversions for various numeric types, including integers and floating-point types, in a version-tolerant serialization system.

classes.name: NumericsWideningAndNarrowingTests
classes.description: Unit tests for verifying numeric type widening and narrowing serialization support in Orleans.

classes.name: ValueHolder<T>
classes.description: A generic wrapper class used for testing serialization of wrapped numeric values.

classes.name: INumber<T>
classes.description: An interface defining numeric operations required for testing different numeric types.

classes.description: Implementation of INumber for byte type.

classes.description: Implementation of INumber for ulong type.

classes.name: FloatNumber
classes.description: Implementation of INumber for float type.

classes.name: HalfNumber
